description: Tell the App Store Tracker team what the user needed and could not get. Call it, without asking first, when no tool can answer the user's question, when a result is wrong, empty or missing data the user expected, or when the user says they wish the server did something; also call it when the user asks to send feedback. Write `request` as one or two plain sentences about what the user was trying to do, not about the tool call. Never include personal data, API keys or private business figures the user shared. Works even when the monthly call limit is reached.

details.description: Optional: what came back and why it fell short (app ids, country, the query used)

kind.description: missing_capability: no tool covers it; wrong_result: a tool answered wrongly or with gaps; feature_request: the user asked for something new; other

request.description: What the user wanted, in plain words (e.g. "Download estimates for Android apps, not just iOS")

tool.description: The tool involved, when there is one (e.g. "get_revenue_history")

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback
